name: @fireback/complexes
description: TypeScript counterparts of fireback's Go `complexes` package (modules/fireback/complexes/*.go) - value types like TString (a locale -> value translatable string) that (de)serialize to/from the API the same way their Go side does. Plain TypeScript, no dependencies (not even React) - safe for any project, frontend or backend-adjacent tooling, that talks to a fireback API.
